items.item_text: Please ensure your resume and application includes ALL relevant certifications and licenses. Any applications missing these requirements will
CRT (R) (M) Mammography license – required
BLS/CPR certification from American Heart Association or American Red Cross – required
ARRT (M) license within one year of hire – required
Associate’s Degree or Higher – preferred
At least 1 year of experience in Breast Imaging – preferred
At least 1 year of DEXA experience – preferred
Breast Ultrasound experience - preferred

Under the direction of the Breast Imaging Manager and Medical Director, the Mammography Technologist performs high-quality diagnostic and screening mammography using a variety of mammography equipment. The technologist provides compassionate, patient-centered care while ensuring compliance with departmental, hospital, and regulatory standards.
Perform digital mammography examinations and assist the Radiologist with procedures as needed.
Prepare patients for examinations, explain procedures, address questions and concerns, and ensure patient comfort, privacy, and dignity throughout the visit.
Review imaging requests for appropriateness and coordinate examinations with other departments and services as needed.
Follow established MQSA, quality assurance, quality control, and radiation safety standards, including maintaining accurate documentation and tracking required data.
Maintain accurate records, ensure requisitions are complete, and appropriately document procedures performed.
Maintain a clean, organized, and well-stocked work area and monitor supply levels to ensure adequate inventory.
Inspect equipment and report maintenance or repair needs; ensure equipment is functioning within established safety and performance standards.
Follow infection prevention, health and safety, confidentiality, and departmental policies and procedures.
Provide first aid and appropriate assistance in the event of a patient emergency until additional support is available.

Communicate effectively and professionally with patients, families, physicians, nurses, and coworkers while demonstrating a commitment to excellent customer service and the Health System's C-I-CARE standards.
Float between UCLA Health Breast Imaging Centers and participate in rotating shifts as needed.

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Ability to identify and recognize contraindications for exams. (Radiology Only)
Ability to prioritize work, handling multiple tasks to completion, within the time allotted
Ability to respond efficiently to expressed needs of referring services, physicians and patients
Excellent interpersonal skills effectively and diplomatically with patients, visitors, hospital staff, physicians, and other
Knowledge of medical terminology, with ability to distinguish between- types of procedures within the assigned department(s) and medical diagnoses
